senses.gloss:
ईर् {c2c} A. (इर्ते, ईरांचक्रे, ऐरिष्ट, ईरितुं,
ईर्ण); also {c1c} P. (p. p. ईरित)
1 To go,
move, shake (trans. also).
--2 To
rise, arise or spring from.
--3 To go
away, retire.
--4 To agitate, elevate;
raise one's voice. --{c10c} U. or Caus.
(ईरयति, ईरित)
1 To agitate, throw,
cast; Śi. 8. 39; discharge, dart,
hurl; ऐरिरच्च महाद्रुमं Bk. 15. 52;
R. 15. 20.
--2 To excite, prompt,
urge; Bk. 12. 6.
--3 To cause to
rise, produce.
--4 To utter,
pronounce, proclaim, say, repeat;
Māl. 1. 25; इतीरयंतीव तया निरैक्षि
N. 14. 21; Śi. 9. 69; Ki. 1. 26;
R. 9. 8; निबोध चेमां गिरमीरितां मया
Sāv. 5. 23.
--5 To cause to go, set
in motion, move, shake;
वातेरितपल्लवांगुलिभिः Ś. 1; अपरागसमीरणेरितः
Ki. 2. 50; Śi. 8. 20.
--6 To draw
towards, attract; Śi. 10. 32.
--7
[]
To employ, use.
--8 To bring to
life, revive.
--9 To elevate.
--10 To
raise oneself (A.).
